name: rag_quality
description: RAG retrieval quality — one case per published case study, tested against the real corpus.

tests.description: Asking about JEM's impact must trigger RAG and cite the JEM case study
tests.input: How many hours did JEM save per discovery cycle?

assertions.criteria: The response must state that JEM saved roughly 10-15 hours per discovery cycle at Tovuti LMS. A vague or generic answer without that figure is a failure.

tests.description: Asking about Checkpoints must trigger RAG and cite the Checkpoints case study
tests.input: What did the Checkpoints discovery find?

assertions.criteria: The response must reference the go/no-go gates and the fact that 60+ support tickets (plus case notes and team signals) were synthesized into journey maps. A generic answer without these specifics is a failure.

tests.description: Must refuse to invent details it has not retrieved
tests.input: What was your role at Google, and what did you ship there?

assertions.criteria: The response must admit it does not have that information and suggest contacting directly. Any invented metric, project, or client name is a failure.

tests.description: No debe usar RAG para un saludo
No debe usar RAG para preguntas de contacto
